name: io.polytest/mcp
title: PolyTest
description: Read historical Polymarket crypto Up/Down market data: prices, snapshots, and order books.

tools.name: polytest_list_markets
tools.description: Lists Up/Down markets of one market_type for one coin. Use it to find a market_id before reading snapshots or a price series. Returns market rows, newest first by start time, each with its window, opening and closing spot price, winner, volume, and status. Use status, not winner, to tell whether a market is still running. coin is btc, eth, or sol, and 4hr and 24hr markets exist for btc only. start_time and end_time filter on the market start time. PolyTest loads new markets in batches, and note says so when the newest market is hours old. Costs 1 API request. To continue, call again with offset set to next_offset while stop is "more". stop "tier_window" means the plan does not cover the requested markets. If truncated is true, rows were cut to keep the result small and next_offset points at the first cut row.

coin.description: Coin symbol in lowercase: btc, eth, or sol. 4hr and 24hr markets exist for btc only.

start_time.description: ISO 8601. Keeps markets that start at or after this time. No zone means UTC.

end_time.description: ISO 8601. Keeps markets that start at or before this time. No zone means UTC.

offset.description: Rows to skip. Pass next_offset from the previous page.

tools.name: polytest_get_market
tools.description: Returns one market by market_id or by slug. Pass exactly one of them. A slug is the last path segment of a Polymarket event URL, as in https://polymarket.com/event/<slug>, and the whole URL works too. Use it to resolve a Polymarket link or to read the full record of a market, including token ids and resolution fields. Costs 1 API request.

market_id.description: PolyTest market id. Pass this or slug, not both.

slug.description: A Polymarket event URL, or its last path segment. Pass this or market_id, not both.

tools.name: polytest_get_snapshots
tools.description: Returns snapshots of one market, oldest first. Each row has time, spot_price, price_up, and price_down. Use it for tick detail in a short time range. For the shape of a whole market, use polytest_get_price_series. A market has about 8 snapshots per second, so narrow the range with start_time and end_time. With include_orderbook each row also has the Up and Down order books, cut to orderbook_depth levels per side, and a page holds at most 20 rows. The book at one moment is this tool with start_time set to that moment, limit 1, and include_orderbook true. Costs 1 API request. To continue, call again with offset set to next_offset while stop is "more". stop "snapshot_offset_cap" means offsets end at 100000, so move start_time forward to continue. If truncated is true, rows were cut to keep the result small and next_offset points at the first cut row.

market_id.description: PolyTest market id from polytest_list_markets or polytest_get_market.

start_time.description: ISO 8601. Keeps snapshots at or after this time. No zone means UTC.

end_time.description: ISO 8601. Keeps snapshots at or before this time. No zone means UTC.

limit.description: Rows per page. At most 20 with order books.

offset.description: Rows to skip. Pass next_offset from the previous page.

include_orderbook.description: Adds the Up and Down order books to each row.

orderbook_depth.description: Price levels kept per side of each book.

tools.name: polytest_get_limits
tools.description: Returns the plan behind the current credential, an API key or a signed-in account: tier, rate limits, concurrency cap, data access, key cap, and trial budget. data_access gives how many of the most recent markets of each type the plan can read. A null cap means no cap. trial_budget is what a free trial may use in total over its 3 days. It applies only during a trial and does not show how much is left. Use it before a large read or after a plan or rate limit error. Costs 1 API request.

tools.name: polytest_get_price_series
tools.description: Returns evenly spaced price points across one market, oldest first. Use it to see the shape of a market without paging through snapshots. It splits the market window, or the part of it inside start_time and end_time, into samples equal buckets and returns the first snapshot of each bucket. Each point has time, spot_price, price_up, and price_down. empty_buckets counts the buckets with no snapshot, and note says where the data ends when the last buckets are empty. For a market still running, the range stops at the current time. Costs 1 + samples API requests, which is 21 with the default. The result is complete and has no paging. For more detail, raise samples or call polytest_get_snapshots on a short range.

market_id.description: PolyTest market id from polytest_list_markets or polytest_get_market.

samples.description: Number of buckets. Each one costs 1 API request.

start_time.description: ISO 8601. Start of the range. Defaults to the market start. No zone means UTC.

end_time.description: ISO 8601. End of the range. Defaults to the market end. No zone means UTC.
